# Healthcare MCP connectors

2 healthcare connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All healthcare connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/healthcare](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/healthcare).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [FHIR R4](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/fhir-to-mcp) | Any HL7 FHIR R4 server: search and read Patients, Observations, Conditions, Encounters, MedicationRequests, DiagnosticReports and any other resource type, plus the server's own capability statement. | 11 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fhir-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fhir-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fhir-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fhir-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fhir-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fhir-to-muse) |
| [Medmis](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/medmis-to-mcp) | Medmis clinic management platform (Russia): branches, specialists and schedules, appointments, patients, invoices, payments, price list, stock, to-do tasks and occupational check-ups. | 31 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-medmis-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-medmis-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-medmis-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-medmis-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-medmis-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-medmis-to-muse) |
